{{Quote|What's happening, sir?''"<br />"''Bothans have sent a task force to destroy or capture the shipyards here.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] during the raid|<ref name="Exile">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref>}}
A '''raid''' took place in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], when the [[Confederation]] attacked the [[Gyndine Shipyards]] so as to put a dent in [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] production.

==The raid==
{{Quote|What the ''brix'' is going on?|Han Solo, witnessing the battle|<ref name="Exile" />}}
The Confederation sent a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] task force in order to further incapacitate the Galactic Alliance's supply of [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. With a [[Bothan Assault Cruiser]] and a goodly supply of Howlrunner fighters, the task force leapt straight for Gyndine, using the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]] to serve as a means of deceleration, the better to retain the element of surprise.

Immediately after dropping out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], a small detachment of the task force attacked the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], which was leaving for [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. After suffering numerous casualties, the taskforce returned to assaulting the [[Gyndine Shipyards|shipyards]].

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] also witnessed the raid from the ''Falcon'', and evacuated his [[Tendrando Refueling and Repair Station|station]] over the planet to avoid harm coming to his staff.

The attack was noted along with a string of related operations at an Alliance Intelligence briefing regarding the Confederation's tactics.<ref name="Exile" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Raid on Gyndine appears in ''Exile'' by [[Aaron Allston]], the fourth novel in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series. The Raid occurs as a minor incident, and is referenced later in the novel.
